There are a high number of referrals to the single rota'd on-call neurosurgical specialist registrar every day. The system for making and receiving the referrals is not fit for purpose, with inefficient delays, miscommunications and confusion occurring. The use of the UHW switchboard and bleeping the doctor is archaic, and does not utilise technology as it should. Further, if the on-call doctor is in surgery or dealing with an emergency, there is no back up doctor to field the referrals, which
delays and miscommunications in neurosurgical referrals
